results.name: Side Lying Leg Lift Left
instructions: Lie on your right side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Rest your head on your right arm and place your left hand on your hips.
Slowly lift your left leg straight up towards the ceiling, keeping it straight and in line with your body.
Hold the top position for a moment, feeling the contraction in your outer thigh and hip.
Slowly lower your leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left side and perform the exercise with your right leg.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it.
Ensure your leg stays straight and in line with your body throughout the movement.
Avoid using momentum to lift your leg; focus on using your hip and thigh muscles.
results.description: Side Lying Leg Lift Left is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abductors.

results.name: Side Lying Leg Lift Right
instructions: Lie on your left side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Rest your head on your left arm and place your right hand on your hips.
Slowly lift your right leg straight up towards the ceiling, keeping it straight and in line with your body.
Hold the top position for a moment, feeling the contraction in your outer thigh and hip.
Slowly lower your leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your right side and perform the exercise with your left leg.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it.
Ensure your leg stays straight and in line with your body throughout the movement.
Avoid using momentum to lift your leg; focus on using your hip and thigh muscles.
results.description: Side Lying Leg Lift Right is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abductors.

results.name: Single Leg Calf Raise Leg Press Machine
instructions: Lie on the leg press machine and straighten your left leg, placing your forefoot on the platform, while your heel hangs off the edge. Your right foot should be resting on the floor.
Press through your forefoot to lift the platform upward by extending your ankle and squeezing your calf at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position with control, ensuring you achieve a full range of motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the right leg.
tips: Keep your knee slightly bent to reduce strain on your joints.
Ensure your heel drops below the edge of the platform to achieve a full range of motion.
Maintain a steady pace to ensure consistent tension on the muscles.
results.description: Single Leg Calf Raise Leg Press Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Quadriceps.

results.name: Single Leg Incline 45 Degree Leg Press Machine
instructions: Lie on the leg press machine and place your left foot flat on the platform while your right foot rests on the floor.
Engage your core and keep your back pressed against the seat. Release the safety handles of the leg press machine.
Press through your left foot to extend your leg fully, pushing the platform upward.
Slowly lower the platform back down to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the right leg.
tips: Exhale as you press the platform upward and inhale as you lower it back down.
Ensure your knee stays aligned with your toes to avoid unnecessary strain.
Keep your knee slightly bent at the top of the movement to reduce strain on your joints.
results.description: Single Leg Incline 45 Degree Leg Press Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Core.

results.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift Dumbbell
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand. Shift your weight onto the right leg and keep it straight.
Hinge at your hips, extending your left leg straight back while lowering the dumbbell towards the floor.
Continue lowering until your upper body and extended leg are parallel to the floor and level from ankle to shoulders.
Return to the starting position by driving through your standing heel. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
tips: Exhale as you lower the dumbbell and inhale as you return to the start.
Maintain a slight bend in the standing knee to avoid joint strain.
Practice the movement without weights to master the form before adding resistance.
results.description: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift Dumbbell is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Abdominals, Calves.

results.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlifts Right Cable Resistance Band
instructions: Attach one end of the resistance band to a low anchor point and hold the other end in your right hand. Stand on your left leg with your right leg slightly bent and your left foot firmly on the floor.
Hinge at your hips and lower your torso until it's parallel to the floor while extending your right leg straight back, keeping your left knee slightly bent.
Return to the starting position by driving your hips forward and bringing your right leg back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
tips: Exhale as you hinge forward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Maintain a slight bend in your standing knee for balance and stability.
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
results.description: Single Leg Romanian Deadlifts Right Cable Resistance Band is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Sissy Squat Bodyweight
instructions: Stand tall holding a support for balance, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto your toes and lean your torso back as you bend your knees forward.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your quadriceps, keeping hips and torso in a straight line.
Push through the balls of your feet to return to the start.
tips: Advanced for the knees; go only as low as is comfortable.
Keep your hips extended, not bent.
results.description: Sissy Squat Bodyweight is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Core.

results.name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Position yourself under the bar of a smith machine, resting it across your shoulders, and hold it firmly with both hands. Place your right foot back on a bench or box behind you, ensuring your left foot is firmly planted on the floor in front.
Lower your body by bending your left knee, keeping your torso upright and your right knee pointing towards the floor.
Continue lowering until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee is close to, but not touching the floor.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, extending your left leg fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your right leg.
tips: Ensure your front knee stays in line with your toes to avoid unnecessary strain on the knee joint.
Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward or backward excessively.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down.
results.description: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Position yourself under the bar of a smith machine, resting it across your shoulders, and hold it firmly with both hands. Place your feet shoulder-width apart with your toes pointing forward.
Lift your heels off the floor by pushing through your forefeet, raising your body upwards.
Continue lifting until you are standing on your forefeet, then slowly lower your heels back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your heels and inhaling as you lower them back down.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Ensure your knees remain slightly bent to avoid knee strain.
results.description: Smith Machine Calf Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Heels Elevated Squats
instructions: Place a small plate or wedge under your heels and step under the Smith bar with your feet close together.
Unrack the bar with it resting on your upper back.
Squat down, letting your knees travel forward, until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive back up and repeat.
tips: The raised heels put the focus on the quadriceps.
Keep your torso upright.
results.description: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Heels Elevated Squats is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.
